tug.definition:
n. a sudden abrupt pull
v. pull hard
v. strive and make an effort to reach a goal
v. tow (a vessel) with a tug
tug.translation:
n. 用力拉, 拖曳, 苦干, 挣扎, 绳索
v. 用力拉

tug of war.translation: n. 拔河，两派间的激烈竞争

tug-of-war.definition:
n. any hard struggle between equally matched groups
n. a contest in which teams pull of opposite ends of a rope; the team dragged across a central line loses
tug-of-war.translation: n. 拔河, 激烈的竞争

tugboat.definition: n. a powerful small boat designed to pull or push larger ships

tuggy.translation:
tuggy (uncountable)
(informal) A game played by a person with a dog, in which they both take hold of a toy or other object and attempt to pull it away from the other.
